title: Policy-driven per-route geo-locks and automated residency evidence workflows
creator: Liam O'Connor
description: Goal: ship a flexible per-route geographic locking feature for the Hosted API plus an automated evidence-generation pipeline that produces timeboxed audit bundles for compliance reviewers. The feature must let tenants set default residency & retention at the account level and optionally enforce immutable geo-locks at the API-route level (e.g., POST /payments => eu-only). The implementation should enforce residency at the gateway, produce signed evidence exports (hashes + retention timeline), and integrate with the Console UI and retention automation so customers can get periodic attestations without manual work.
acceptance_criteria: Account-level residency default can be set to one or more regions from the catalog (us-east1, eu-west1, ap-southeast1)
API routes can be configured with an immutable "geo-lock" flag that prevents request routing outside selected regions
If a route-level geo-lock exists, attempts to change account defaults that would violate the lock are rejected with a clear error and audit trail
Gateway enforces residency decision at request time with <5ms additional latency in p95 for small payloads
Automated evidence export: system can generate a signed bundle that proves where requests were served (region, timestamp, model variant) for a given tenant and time window
Console provides a per-tenant dashboard showing route residency, retention policies, and next scheduled evidence export
Owners can schedule recurring export jobs (daily/weekly/monthly) and download a ZIP containing logs, retention metadata, and signed manifests
End-to-end tests and a security review are completed prior to GA
Migration plan for existing tenants with heterogeneous route settings is documented and tested
work_items: PM: finalize policy semantics (immutable vs advisory locks, escalation paths)
Design: wireframes for per-route residency UI + export scheduling
Eng-Gateway: residency enforcement hook + fast path routing decision
Eng-Runtime: surface model-variant region metadata in request traces
Eng-Console: table view + route editor + evidence export controls
Eng-Infra: signed export generation, bundle storage retention, KMS integration
SRE: define p95 latency target and create synthetic tests
Docs: how-to, API examples, and compliance FAQ
Legal/Compliance: define required fields for evidence bundles
risks_and_mitigation: Risk: misconfigured locks could unintentionally block traffic -> Mitigation: must include dry-run mode and preflight validation when applying geo-locks
Risk: evidence bundles could expose sensitive data -> Mitigation: only include metadata (region, timestamp, model id, request id) and provide redaction guidance; encrypt bundles with tenant KMS
Risk: routing failures during rollout -> Mitigation: implement gradual rollout with canary domains and automated fallback to account defaults when safe
rollout_plan: Phase 1 (canary): UI + gateway enforcement behind feature flag for internal tenants and early-access customers
Phase 2: automated evidence export added and KMS-protected bundles for EAA customers
Phase 3: GA with self-serve scheduling and docs
Migration: provide a migration tool that scans all routes and highlights conflicts between account defaults and route-level locks
